name: Sergei Korolev
contribution: A Soviet rocket engineer and spacecraft designer who led the development of the Soviet space program during the early years of the Space Race.

checks.lead: Sergei Pavlovich Korolev (12 January 1907 [O.S. 30 December 1906] – 14 January 1966) was a Soviet rocket engineer and spacecraft designer who led the development of the Soviet space program during the early years of the Space Race.
